summary: A CBS Sports timeline of the rumored romance between Taylor Swift and Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce, from his friendship-bracelet remarks in June 2023 through Swift attending her fifth Chiefs game. It covers the rumors, Swift's game appearances, comments from Mahomes, Reid, Belichick and Jerry Jones, and the "Taylor Swift effect" on jersey sales, ratings and tickets. It also notes the NFL leaning into the coverage while the Kelce brothers said it was overdone.
one_line: Timeline of the rumored Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce romance and its outsized impact on the NFL, from June to October 2023.
key_facts: On June 29, Travis Kelce made friendship bracelets for newcomers at an NFL tight ends camp, saying he was "taking a page out of Taylor Swift's book."

On July 26, Kelce said on the "New Heights" podcast, which he does with his brother Jason Kelce of the Philadelphia Eagles, that he made Swift a friendship bracelet with his number on it but did not get to meet her at her concert.
Swift attended the Chiefs' Week 3 game against the Chicago Bears on Sept. 24; Kelce caught a three-yard touchdown to put Kansas City up 41-0, and the Chiefs won 41-10 to improve to 2-1.
At the Sept. 24 game Swift sat next to Kelce's mom, Donna Kelce, in the box, and the two were seen talking and laughing.
Patrick Mahomes said Kelce told him at the last minute that Swift was coming; Chiefs head coach Andy Reid quipped, "I set them up."
After Swift's first game, Kelce jersey sales rose 400%, his podcast hit No. 1 overall on Apple, and he gained over 380,000 Instagram followers.
According to Front Office Sports, 24.3 million people watched the Chiefs-Bears game, making it the No. 1 game of that week.
Bill Belichick said, "Travis Kelce's had a lot of big catches in his career. This would be the biggest."
On Oct. 1 Swift attended Chiefs-Jets with Blake Lively, Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman; the Chiefs won 23-20.
On Oct. 5 the NFL changed its X bio to "NFL (Taylor's Version)" and called the Swift-Kelce story a "pop cultural moment."
On Oct. 6 Travis Kelce said the NFL was "overdoing it a little bit" with the coverage, and Jason Kelce said the NFL is not used to celebrities at games.
On Oct. 15 Kelce had a cameo in an "SNL" skit about Swift's game coverage while Swift introduced musical guest Ice Spice.
On Oct. 22 Swift attended her fifth Chiefs game, against the Chargers, seated next to Brittany Mahomes, having now been at games on CBS, NBC, Fox, ESPN and Amazon.
